lead: Stay in the centre to be walkable to the defence, the bars and the tram — unless you're with us at the reservoir.

hotels.name: Hotel Grandezza
hotels.blurb: Palace-style on Zelný trh square, fluent English staff, 5 min from the station.

hotels.name: Grand Palace Brno
hotels.blurb: Elegant, edge of old town, spa + lobby piano bar.

hotels.name: Grandhotel Brno
hotels.blurb: Classic, directly opposite the train/bus station (handy for the Vienna bus crowd).

hotels.name: Hotel Avion
hotels.blurb: Solid mid-range, dead centre on Česká.

hotels.name: Internesto Apartments
hotels.blurb: Apartment-style with kitchens, good for families sharing.

hotels.name: Maximus Resort
hotels.blurb: On the Brno reservoir; spa, pools, lakeside sauna. The natural overflow for anyone who can't fit in the rented house but wants the lakeside weekend.
